-- ============================================
-- Supabase Schema для Crypto Micro-Tracker
-- ============================================
-- Запустите этот SQL в редакторе SQL в Supabase Dashboard

-- Включение расширений
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- Таблица настроек пользователя (для будущей синхронизации)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_settings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    preferences JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    theme VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'light',
    currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'USD'
);

-- Индексы для производительности
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_settings_user_id ON user_settings(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_settings_updated_at ON user_settings(updated_at);

-- Включение защиты на уровне строк (RLS)
ALTER TABLE user_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Политика: анонимные пользователи могут читать свои настройки (если есть user_id)
CREATE POLICY "user_settings_select" ON user_settings
    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);

-- Политика: авторизованные пользователи могут создавать настройки
CREATE POLICY "user_settings_insert" ON user_settings
    FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);

-- Политика: авторизованные пользователи могут обновлять свои настройки
CREATE POLICY "user_settings_update" ON user_settings
    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Политика: авторизованные пользователи могут удалять свои настройки
CREATE POLICY "user_settings_delete" ON user_settings
    FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Таблица для хранения истории цен (опционально, для фазы 2)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS price_history (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    coin_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    price_usd DECIMAL(18, 8) NOT NULL,
    volume_24h DECIMAL(18, 8),
    market_cap DECIMAL(18, 8),
    INDEX idx_price_history_coin_id (coin_id),
    INDEX idx_price_history_created_at (created_at)
);

-- Включение RLS для истории цен
ALTER TABLE price_history ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "price_history_select" ON price_history
    FOR SELECT USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "price_history_insert" ON price_history
    FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);

-- ============================================
-- Инициализация данных по умолчанию
-- ============================================
-- Если пользователь создает настройки, они будут созданы автоматически
-- при первом входе

-- ============================================
-- Хранилище (Storage)

code_snapshot./supabase/schema.sql:
-- Propa AI Database Schema
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor

-- Enable UUID extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- Users table (extends Supabase auth.users)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  full_name TEXT,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  subscription_tier TEXT DEFAULT 'free',
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Properties table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS properties (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude DECIMAL(10, 8),
  longitude DECIMAL(11, 8),
  city TEXT,
  state TEXT,
  zip_code TEXT,
  country TEXT DEFAULT 'US',
  property_type TEXT CHECK (property_type IN ('residential', 'commercial', 'industrial', 'land', 'mixed_use')),
  parcel_number TEXT,
  zoning_code TEXT,
  jurisdiction TEXT,
  total_area_sqft INTEGER,
  building_area_sqft INTEGER,
  year_built INTEGER,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Property analyses table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS property_analyses (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  property_id UUID REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  analysis_type TEXT CHECK (analysis_type IN ('photo', 'location', 'address', 'link')),
  decision_score INTEGER CHECK (decision_score >= 0 AND decision_score <= 100),
  risk_score INTEGER,
  return_score INTEGER,
  stability_score INTEGER,
  verdict JSONB,
  red_flags JSONB,
  vision_analysis JSONB,
  market_metrics JSONB,
  zoning_analysis JSONB,
  environmental_data JSONB,
  confidence_level TEXT CHECK (confidence_level IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
  analysis_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days'),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Evidence items table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evidence_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  analysis_id UUID REFERENCES property_analyses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  evidence_type TEXT CHECK (evidence_type IN ('zoning_map', 'price_chart', 'noise_map', 'sunlight_data', 'comparable_sale', 'permit', 'satellite_image')),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  confidence TEXT CHECK (confidence IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
  data JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Zoning rules table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zoning_rules (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  jurisdiction TEXT NOT NULL,
  zoning_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  allowed_uses JSONB,
  far_max DECIMAL(5, 2),
  height_limit_ft INTEGER,
  density_limit INTEGER,
  setbacks JSONB,
  special_conditions JSONB,
  effective_date DATE,
  expires_date DATE,
  source_url TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(jurisdiction, zoning_code)
);

-- User saved locations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_saved_locations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  property_id UUID REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  tags TEXT[],
  alert_settings JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(user_id, property_id)
);

-- Market trends cache
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market_trends_cache (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  location_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  property_type TEXT,
  price_per_sqft DECIMAL(10, 2),
  rent_per_sqft DECIMAL(10, 2),
  price_trend_5y DECIMAL(5, 2),
  rent_trend_5y DECIMAL(5, 2),
  days_on_market INTEGER,
  cap_rate DECIMAL(5, 2),
  noi DECIMAL(12, 2),
  comparables JSONB,
  valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(location_hash, property_type)
);

-- Environmental data cache
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS environmental_data_cache (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  location_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  noise_level_db INTEGER,
  sunlight_hours DECIMAL(4, 1),
  air_quality_index INTEGER,
  flood_risk TEXT,
  traffic_score INTEGER,
  walk_score INTEGER,
  transit_score INTEGER,
  valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(location_hash)
);

-- Row Level Security Policies

-- Enable RLS on all tables
ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE properties ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE property_analyses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE evidence_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE zoning_rules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE user_saved_locations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE market_trends_cache ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE environmental_data_cache ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Users policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile" ON users
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON users
  FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id);

-- Properties policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own properties" ON properties
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own properties" ON properties
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can update own properties" ON properties
  FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can delete own properties" ON properties
  FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Property analyses policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own analyses" ON property_analyses
  FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM properties 
      WHERE properties.id = property_analyses.property_id 
      AND properties.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own analyses" ON property_analyses
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM properties 
      WHERE properties.id = property_analyses.property_id 
      AND properties.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Evidence items policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own evidence" ON evidence_items
  FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM property_analyses pa
      JOIN properties p ON pa.property_id = p.id
      WHERE pa.id = evidence_items.analysis_id 
      AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Zoning rules (public read)
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view zoning rules" ON zoning_rules
  FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- User saved locations policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own saved locations" ON user_saved_locations
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own saved locations" ON user_saved_locations
  FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Cache tables (public read, authenticated write)
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can read cache" ON market_trends_cache
  FOR SELECT USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can write cache" ON market_trends_cache
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);

CREATE POLICY "Anyone can read environmental cache" ON environmental_data_cache
  FOR SELECT USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can write environmental cache" ON environmental_data_cache
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);

-- Indexes for performance
CREATE INDEX idx_properties_user_id ON properties(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_properties_location ON properties(latitude, longitude);
CREATE INDEX idx_property_analyses_property_id ON property_analyses(property_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_items_analysis_id ON evidence_items(analysis_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_zoning_rules_jurisdiction_code ON zoning_rules(jurisdiction, zoning_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_user_saved_locations_user_id ON user_saved_locations(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_market_trends_cache_location ON market_trends_cache(location_hash);
CREATE INDEX idx_environmental_cache_location ON environmental_data_cache(location_hash);

-- Storage bucket for property photos
-- Note: Run this in Supabase Storage section
-- Bucket name: property_photos
-- Public: false
-- Allowed mime types: image/*

-- Insert sample zoning rules
INSERT INTO zoning_rules (jurisdiction, zoning_code, allowed_uses, far_max, height_limit_ft, density_limit, setbacks, special_conditions) VALUES
('Los Angeles, CA', 'R1', '["single_family", "home_office", "accessory_dwelling"]', 0.5, 35, 1, '{"front": 20, "rear": 15, "side": 5}', '["Minimum lot size 5000 sqft"]'),
('Los Angeles, CA', 'C2', '["commercial", "retail", "office", "restaurant", "service"]', 3.0, 65, NULL, '{"front": 0, "rear": 0, "side": 0}', '["Parking requirements apply", "Signage restrictions"]'),
('New York, NY', 'R6', '["multi_family", "commercial_ground", "community_facility"]', 2.43, 70, 120, '{"front": 10, "rear": 30, "side": 8}', '["Affordable housing requirements may apply"]'),
('Miami, FL', 'IU', '["industrial", "warehouse", "manufacturing", "distribution"]', 2.0, 45, NULL, '{"front": 25, "rear": 25, "side": 15}', '["Truck loading requirements", "Noise restrictions"]');

-- Function to update updated_at timestamp
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ language 'plpgsql';

-- Triggers for updated_at
CREATE TRIGGER update_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TRIGGER update_properties_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON properties
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();
